paper_title: Physics-Informed LSTM hyperparameters selection for gearbox fault detection
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 555 presents a UNSW gear tooth wear case study using the run-to-failure dataset and cites Ke Feng's Gear wear run-to-failure dataset, Version 1, with DOI 10.17632/p2yryg9k6z.1. The Mendeley record independently verifies that dataset identity. Stage-1 has an extra r in the DOI suffix; VA000055 repairs that source typo while preserving PRL000169.
evidence_location: paper Section 4.2 UNSW gear tooth wear dataset and reference 41; Mendeley Version 1 metadata

paper_title: Comparative Study between Physics-Informed CNN and PCA in Induction Motor Broken Bars MCSA Detection
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 563 states that the study dataset was generated in the LIAS laboratory of Poitiers, describes the induction-motor experimental bench and measurements, and gives https://www.lias-lab.fr/mcsa in its Data Availability Statement. The current MCSA-DC page independently documents the same rotor-bar-failure dataset. PRL000172 is verified.
evidence_location: paper Section 3.3 and Data Availability Statement; MCSA-DC overview/apparatus/download/licence sections

paper_title: Nearshore Bathymetry from ICESat-2 LiDAR and Sentinel-2 Imagery Datasets Using Physics-Informed CNN
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 571 explicitly extracts reference bathymetric points from ICESat-2 ATL03 data and lists the exact NSIDC Version 5 URL in its Data Availability Statement. NSIDC independently verifies ATL03 Version 5, DOI 10.5067/ATLAS/ATL03.005, its photon-data description and documentation. PRL000175 is verified even though Version 5 is now retired in favor of a newer release.
evidence_location: paper Section 3.2.1 and Data Availability Statement; NSIDC Version 5 landing page
